en: Yesterday: two coins, worth thirty pence together. And one of them is not a ten pence coin.
The trick? It only said ONE of them is not ten pence. That one is the twenty pence!
And the other coin? It is the ten pence. Twenty plus ten: thirty pence!
Power cut! Person one has to get ready in total darkness.
In the drawer: ten black socks, and ten white socks, all mixed up.
Person one cannot see a thing, and needs just one matching pair.
So, how many socks must Person one take out, to be sure of a pair?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
